chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 432: Chaos Eye, Four North Winds & Zhuge Yuan's Arrival
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang faces the eye of Chaos, four cloned North Winds, and a wave of Zuowandao pouring in as Zhuge Yuan makes a dramatic entrance through a golden wall.
og_title: The Mahjong Colors — Chaos, Four North Winds, and Zhuge Yuan's Grand Entry
og_description: The golden tree looms. The eye of Chaos stares. The Zuowandao multiply beyond reason. And Zhuge Yuan bursts through the wall. Chapter 432 is a full-blown cosmic mahjong showdown.
twitter_title: Chaos eye. Four North Winds. Zhuge Yuan crashes through a golden wall. The Dao-Twisted World's mahjong table just got a LOT bigger.
twitter_description: Li Huowang's hunt for the Heart-Element North Wind explodes into a reality-warping siege of Zuowandao, and Zhuge Yuan arrives with an army of impossible tiles.

lore_anchors.definition: The central ritual construct of the Emperor of Liang; its branches are formed from agonized, human-faced six-clawed golden dragons pierced by inverted * characters.
A giant, emotionless eye in the sky that embodies the concept of Chaos; its droning chant is lethal to those without strong willpower.
One of the four wind tiles in a mahjong set; also the alias of the Heart-Element body-swapper Li Huowang is hunting. There are now four apparent copies.
The Emperor of Liang's most powerful advisor, an old man wielding a sword engraved with the Twenty-Eight Mansions—an ancient Chinese constellation system.
An ancient Chinese astronomical division of the sky into 28 lodges, used in astrology, calendar-making, and Daoist magical practices.
Zhuge Yuan's weapon; a scholar's writing brush used as a magical tool, often associated with recording or rewriting reality.
A Chinese folk deity of prosperity; in this chapter, it appears as a Zuowandao member's mahjong tile face, indicating an extended tile set.
The "Red Center" mahjong tile; in Li Huowang's hallucination, it manifests as a talkative, smug Zuowandao figure.
